enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the whole addon on or off.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: What others see when they click "Profile" in the Freundeskreis wheel. Your birthday lives in "Calendar". Command: /steckbrief

share.name: Share profile
share.description: Other addon users can see your profile.

nickname.name: Name
nickname.description: What you want to be called.

age.name: Age
age.description: Type freely - leave empty if you don't want to show it.

mobPicker.name: Mob identity
mobPicker.description: Which Minecraft mob are you? Type to search.

country.name: Country
country.description: Type freely, e.g. Germany, USA, China, Japan …

openKeys.name: Keys: open your own profile
openKeys.description: Any key combination (one or more keys), only active in-game.

open.name: View your own profile
open.description: This is how others see your profile.

state.name: State / region
state.description: Type anything, e.g. Bavaria, Texas, Ontario …

statePicker.name: Pick German state
statePicker.description: All 16 German states to click. From another country? Just type it in above.

woodPicker.name: Wood frame
woodPicker.description: Wood type for your profile card frame. Click one to select it.

stickerBook.name: Sticker book
stickerBook.description: Give any player with the Freundeskreis addon your head as a sticker – no friendship needed, you just have to be on the same server. Uses LabyConnect, no chat message. Stickers you receive stay in your book forever. Command: /sammelbuch

inWheel.name: Show in wheel
inWheel.description: Shows "Give sticker" in the Freundeskreis ring.

accept.name: Accept stickers
accept.description: Other addon users can give you stickers.

openKeys.name: Keys: open sticker book
openKeys.description: Any key combination (one or more keys), only active in game.

notebook.name: Notebook
notebook.description: Private notes about players – everyone you click or write a note about gets a book on the shelf. Command: /notizbuch

open.name: Open notebook
open.description: Opens the bookshelf with all your friends.

woodPicker.name: Wood type
woodPicker.description: Preview of all wood types for the shelf. Click one to select it.

openKeys.name: Keys: open notebook
openKeys.description: Any key combination (one or more keys), only active in game.

coins.name: Friendship coins
coins.description: Next to your LabyMod friends' names you see a coin showing how long you've been friends. Coin 1 right away, then a new one every 6 months – up to the 20th (Legendary).

enabled.name: Show coins
enabled.description: Shows the friendship coin to the right of your friends' names (never on yourself).

gallery.name: View coins
gallery.description: All 20 coins and when you get them.

hudWidget.name: Set up HUD widget
hudWidget.description: Opens LabyMod's widget editor. Look for "Next birthday" and drag it onto your screen.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: Your friends' birthdays: calendar, birthday notifications, a cake next to the name and a HUD widget. Command: /kalender

birthday.name: Your birthday
birthday.description: DD.MM. (e.g. 14.03.). After saving you have 10 minutes to fix it, then only every 30 days.

reminders.name: Birthday notifications
reminders.description: Get notified when a friend has their birthday – and on your own.

cake.name: Cake next to the name
cake.description: Whoever has their birthday gets a little cake next to their name all day.

openKeys.name: Keys: open calendar
openKeys.description: Any key combination (one or more keys), only active in-game.

album.name: Photo album
album.description: Glue your best screenshots into an album, with a frame and a short caption. Command: /fotoalbum

openKeys.name: Keys: open photo album
openKeys.description: Any key combination (one or more keys), only active in-game.

add.name: Add a photo
add.description: Your screenshots: right-click a picture → "Save to photo album".

share.name: Share photo album
share.description: Other addon users on your server can view your album through the wheel (smaller images).

inWheel.name: Show in wheel
inWheel.description: Shows "Photo album" in the Freundeskreis wheel.

wheel.title: Freundeskreis
wheel.empty: All entries are turned off in the settings.
